qa_pair.question: For this release, inspect the authoritative Shared Stripe merchant section of STANDING_RULES.md. What is the already verified default account ID? Return only the account ID.

In an isolated entry-context fixture, both mandatory documents are readable and their index hashes match, the Guardian timer is active, the exact knowledge-index hook is loaded, and the receipt is successful and fresh. What is the top-level entry status? Return only the status string.

In an isolated fixture, current mandatory reference files are readable but their index hashes are stale. What top-level entry status preserves current filesystem references while reporting degraded automation? Return only the status string.

Inspect the missing-mandatory-reference branch without modifying production. If either required current reference is unavailable, what error code and HTTP status are raised? Return exactly code:status.
For an actor with only merch:read, what are the permitted top-level entry-context keys? Return the keys in alphabetical order, comma-separated without spaces.

In an isolated standing-rules fixture, the authoritative default-merchant paragraph contains two different account IDs. Does merchant extraction pick one or mark the binding unresolved? Return only the resulting stripe_default.status.
What is the maximum age, in milliseconds, of a successful knowledge-index receipt before entry-context automation health reports receipt_stale? Return only the integer threshold.
Which exact drop-in basename must appear under sssbrain-guardian.service.d for the intended Bible-index hook to count as loaded? Return only the basename.

Does this release install a universal hook that executes at the start of every ChatGPT conversation, including conversations that never call SWADEBASE MCP or its native bridges? Return only yes or no.
How many paid provider, embedding, or model-training calls are required by the automatic Bible entry check and existing local document-index hook themselves? Return only the integer count.
